nodes.rationale: External reference system for employee codes, positions, and cost centers.

nodes.label: External Security System
nodes.rationale: Manages users, roles, and permissions outside the GTM core database.

nodes.label: Colaborador Entity
nodes.rationale: The central functional subject of GTM processes; represents stable labor identity.

nodes.label: Persona Entity
nodes.rationale: Represents the unique civil/natural identity of an individual.

nodes.label: Relación Laboral Entity
nodes.rationale: Captures specific employment links, allowing for re-entries and multiple simultaneous payrolls.

nodes.label: Definition of Done - Analyst Stage
nodes.rationale: Defines the completion criteria for the Analyst stage, focusing on functional coverage and conceptual modeling without physical implementation.

nodes.label: Conceptual ER Diagram v1
nodes.rationale: Visual and semantic representation of the core data model and its boundaries with external modules.

nodes.label: GTM Core Requirements
nodes.rationale: Central repository of business rules, entities (Persona, Colaborador), and functional flows for the GTM core.

nodes.label: Confirmed Technology Stack
nodes.rationale: Documents the approved technologies (SQL Server 2017, NestJS, Angular, Kotlin) and architectural boundaries.

nodes.label: Core HR Decisions Guideline
nodes.rationale: Primary source of truth for identity management and labor relationship rules.

nodes.label: DB Restructuring Proposal
